Matching Representations

Facilitation Notes

In this activity, students cut out and analyze graphs, tables, and contexts
representing linear relationships. They use what they have learned about
slopes, y-intercepts, and equations of a line to match either a table, graph, or
scenario with an equation. Students may recognize some of the representations
from previous activities.
